title: DoorDash Rewards Fans This College Football Season with Saturday Deals and Monthly Prizes
summary: Fans work just as hard as anyone on the field, and this season DoorDash is rewarding them for it, from a brand-new car to a shot at a dream house
body_markdown:
**Key Takeaways:**


-


**Don't Fan for Free:** DoorDash's new season-long campaign stars three of college football's biggest names, Lane Kiffin, Jameis Winston, and Reggie Bush, to prove that fans deserve the same star treatment as the players and coaches they cheer for.


-


**A Deal, Every Saturday:** Fans get access to deals every single Saturday just for ordering in for kickoff.


-


**DoorDash Streaks Levels Up:** Every Saturday order during the season unlocks a shot at a new monthly prize, from a car to the grand prize of $757,500 toward a home, sanction-free.*


-


**College Student Gets Their Own Brand Deal:** Because every fan deserves a deal, DoorDash is offering Free Student DashPass to all college students nationwide until 10/12.


-


**Bigger Tailgate Tour:** Growing to 12 schools, with a nine-stop tailgate tour and an all-new fan experience.


DoorDash is kicking off the 2026 college football season with a new campaign, “Don't Fan for Free.” Everybody in college football's got a deal these days: players, coaches, even mascots. Fans work just as hard, but without the credit, and[DoorDash](https://www.doordash.com/p/seasonal-holidays) wants to change that with a campaign that rewards the fans all season long.


To bring it to life, DoorDash tapped three of the biggest personalities in the game: Lane Kiffin, one of the sport's most iconic head coaches; Jameis Winston, a national champion turned NFL veteran; and Reggie Bush, an NFL champion and college football legend. And a few of these names know a thing or two about bending the old rules before name, image, likeness (NIL) made it all fair game. Now, they're the ones telling fans it's their turn to cash in.


**DoorDash Streaks: Weekly Saturday Deals & A New Prize, Every Month**
DoorDash Streaks is built for fans who show up every Saturday of the season, tuning in and ordering in for kickoff, week after week. Order in for kickoff every Saturday and you'll get access to deals, no strings attached. Rack up enough qualifying orders in a month, and you're automatically entered into that month's prize drawing and the grand prize drawing. No extra sign-up needed.


**Here's how it works:** Starting September 5, place qualifying Saturday orders ($20+ subtotal) to hit that month's streak milestone, and get entered into the monthly prize drawing. Complete each month’s streak to be automatically entered into the grand prize drawing.


-


**September's kickoff prize:** Place four qualifying Saturday orders ($20+ subtotal) and automatically get entered to win a brand-new Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat. Another 1,000 fans will each get a $250 DoorDash gift card to host their own game-day watch party.*


-


**The grand prize:** Every month you hit that month's milestone, you also earn an entry into the grand prize drawing and the biggest reward yet, $757,500 toward the house of your dreams, sanction free, plus a new fridge full of a year's supply of Dr Pepper (as defined in the Official Rules).*


And that's just the first reveal, DoorDash will unveil a brand-new monthly prize all season long, so there's always another reason to keep the streak alive. DashPass members also earn two sweepstakes entries for each monthly drawing and grand prize drawing every time their Streak hits that month's milestone.


**From The Field To The Screen**
To bring "Don't Fan for Free" to life on screen, DoorDash tapped Lane Kiffin, Jameis Winston and Reggie Bush for a new campaign that leans into the modern era of NIL. These pros know a little something about being rewarded on and off the field and now, they’re empowering the real MVPs: college football fans.


> "College football fans build their whole week around Saturdays. The tailgates, the multigenerational traditions, and the energy they bring are what make the sport so special," **said Gina Igwe, Vice President of Brand, Creative and Consumer Marketing at DoorDash.** "In the NIL era where everyone in college football has a deal, 'Don't Fan for Free' is DoorDash's way of making sure the fans get one too. With weekly deals and chances to win big every game day, we're making it easier to order in and stay focused on the game."


Directed by the Turner Brothers (Invisible Collective) and produced alongside Mike Teevee, the campaign runs across TV, streaming and social throughout the season.


**The Biggest Tailgate Tour Yet**
Nothing captures college football fandom quite like game day on campus. That’s why DoorDash is teaming up with some of the sport’s biggest schools this season, bringing the experience directly to their biggest fans.


DoorDash is back for another season of college football, partnering with Learfield for a[second year](https://www.learfield.com/2025/08/this-college-football-season-everyones-a-winner-with-doordash/) , and this year's partnership is even bigger, expanding to 11 college programs: University of Michigan, The University of Texas at Austin, University of Georgia, The University of Alabama, University of Oregon, University of Missouri, The Ohio State University, University of Florida, University of Southern California, Indiana University, and University of Oklahoma, and one from Playfly Sports, bringing Louisiana State University into the mix for the first time.


This fall, DoorDash is hitting the road, stopping at some of the season's marquee matchups to introduce an all-new fan experience:


-


Sept. 5: LSU vs. Clemson


-


Sept. 12: Texas vs. Ohio State


-


Sept. 26: USC vs. Oregon


-


Oct. 10: Alabama vs. Georgia


-


Oct. 17: Indiana vs. Ohio State


-


Oct. 24: Michigan vs. Indiana


-


Nov. 7: Florida vs. Oklahoma


-


Nov. 14: Oregon vs. Michigan


-


Nov. 28: Ohio State vs. Michigan


Fans can step through the DoorDash Transfer Portal, and come out the other side an official DoorDash recruit. Fans can suit up with game-day gear, build one-of-a-kind merch and keep an eye out for surprise hourly drops throughout the day. DoorDash will also run local sweepstakes at each partner school, giving fans a chance to win exclusive game-day experiences like tickets, hospitality access, sideline passes, DoorDash gift cards and other VIP perks. Plus, because every fan deserves a deal, DoorDash is offering[Free Student DashPass](https://help.doordash.com/en-us/consumers/article/free-student-dashpass-faqs) to all college students nationwide until 10/12.


> “College football fans bring incredible energy every game day. Together with DoorDash, we’re creating new ways to celebrate that passion, reward loyal fans, and add even more excitement to Saturdays throughout the season,” **said Shawn Hegan, EVP of Global Partnerships at Learfield.**


*NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. Purchase will not increase your chances of winning. Sweepstakes starts at 12:00:01 AM local time on September 5, 2026 and ends at 11:59:59 PM local time on November 28, 2026. Open to legal United States residents residing in the fifty (50) United States, District of Columbia, who have an active DoorDash account, are at least eighteen (18) years of age or the age of majority in their state of residence at time of entry. Visit[bit.ly/DDstreaks](https://help.doordash.com/en-us/consumers/article/doordash-fall-football-streaks-rewards-sweepstakes) for complete Official Rules, eligibility, how to enter for free, earn additional free entries, entry limits, and prize details/restrictions.
